text:
Trailer for a Sherlock Holmes Anime created with Seedance 2.0 and ChatGPT Image 2 on @invideoOfficial

The prompt for the synopsis is below ⬇️ https://t.co/grispnNEph
content:
Use GPT Image 2 to generate an 8-panel, 30-second trailer synopsis by prompting: Inspired by these images, write an eight-panel synopsis for a 30 seconds trailer with the timing, camera directions, and dialogue for a Sherlock Holmes episode trailer.  
Convert the 8-panel synopsis into a two-page synopsis by prompting GPT Image 2: Transform this in a two page synopsis inspired by the style of this character sheet.  
Animate the resulting synopsis in Seedance 2.0, then merge the generated clips into a single trailer using a video editor.

translations.es:
Usa GPT Image 2 para generar una sinopsis de tráiler de 8 paneles y 30 segundos con el prompt: Inspired by these images, write an eight-panel synopsis for a 30 seconds trailer with the timing, camera directions, and dialogue for a Sherlock Holmes episode trailer.  
Convierte la sinopsis de 8 paneles en una sinopsis de dos páginas con el prompt de GPT Image 2: Transform this in a two page synopsis inspired by the style of this character sheet.  
Anima la sinopsis resultante en Seedance 2.0, luego fusiona los clips generados en un solo tráiler usando un editor de video.

[Hilo 2] GPT Image 2 prompt: "Transform this in a two page synopsis inspired by the style of this character sheet.

Resultado abajo en el siguiente post ⬇️ https://t.co/gatMsoUyBL
